-- Author: @toskua, Avocado
module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Prod

/-!
# Half-dimensional totally isotropic subspaces

This file develops a weak, characteristic-free quadratic-form property: the
existence of a half-dimensional subspace on which a quadratic map vanishes.
It provides transport under isometry equivalences, product and scalar
constructions, similarity graphs, a roundness-based recursive step, and the
rank-two base case.

The property includes no nondegeneracy, perpendicular-equality, Lagrangian,
metabolic, or hyperbolic assertion.

## Main declarations

* `QuadraticMap.IsTotallyIsotropic`
* `QuadraticMap.IsRound`
* `QuadraticForm.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace`
* `QuadraticForm.hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_prod_neg_smul_of_not_anisotropic`
* `QuadraticForm.hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_of_not_anisotropic_finrank_two`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u v w v'

namespace QuadraticMap

variable {R : Type u} [CommSemiring R]
variable {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
variable {M' : Type v'} [AddCommMonoid M'] [Module R M']
variable {N : Type w} [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N]

/-- A submodule on which a quadratic map vanishes identically. -/
def IsTotallyIsotropic (Q : QuadraticMap R M N) (H : Submodule R M) : Prop :=
  ∀ x ∈ H, Q x = 0

namespace IsTotallyIsotropic

/-- Total isotropy is preserved by mapping a submodule through an isometry
equivalence. -/
theorem map_isometryEquiv {Q : QuadraticMap R M N}
    {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' N} {H : Submodule R M}
    (hH : Q.IsTotallyIsotropic H) (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :
    Q'.IsTotallyIsotropic (H.map e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap) := by
  rintro y ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩
  change Q' (e x) = 0
  rw [e.map_app]
  exact hH x hx

/-- The product of two totally isotropic submodules is totally isotropic for
the product quadratic map. -/
theorem prod {Q : QuadraticMap R M N} {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' N}
    {H : Submodule R M} {H' : Submodule R M'}
    (hH : Q.IsTotallyIsotropic H) (hH' : Q'.IsTotallyIsotropic H') :
    (Q.prod Q').IsTotallyIsotropic (H.prod H') := by
  rintro ⟨x, y⟩ hxy
  change x ∈ H ∧ y ∈ H' at hxy
  rw [QuadraticMap.prod_apply, hH x hxy.1, hH' y hxy.2, zero_add]

/-- A totally isotropic submodule remains so after scaling the quadratic
map. -/
theorem smul (c : R) {Q : QuadraticMap R M N} {H : Submodule R M}
    (hH : Q.IsTotallyIsotropic H) :
    (c • Q).IsTotallyIsotropic H := by
  intro x hx
  simp [hH x hx]

end IsTotallyIsotropic

/-- A quadratic map is round when its nonzero represented values are exactly
its similarity factors. -/
def IsRound (Q : QuadraticMap R M R) : Prop :=
  ∀ c : R, c ≠ 0 →
    ((∃ x, Q x = c) ↔ (c • Q).Equivalent Q)

namespace IsometryEquiv

/-- Scalar multiplication transports an isometry equivalence. -/
def smul {Q : QuadraticMap R M N} {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' N}
    (c : R) (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :
    (c • Q).IsometryEquiv (c • Q') where
  toLinearEquiv := e.toLinearEquiv
  map_app' x := by simp [e.map_app]

/-- Equality of quadratic maps gives an isometry equivalence with identity
underlying linear equivalence. -/
def ofEq {Q Q' : QuadraticMap R M N} (h : Q = Q') :
    Q.IsometryEquiv Q' where
  toLinearEquiv := LinearEquiv.refl R M
  map_app' x := by cases h; rfl

/-- An isometry equivalence preserves and reflects anisotropy. -/
theorem anisotropic_iff {Q : QuadraticMap R M N}
    {Q' : QuadraticMap R M' N} (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :
    Q.Anisotropic ↔ Q'.Anisotropic := by
  constructor
  · intro hQ y hy
    have hx : Q (e.symm y) = 0 := by
      rw [← e.map_app]
      simpa
    have hzero := hQ _ hx
    simpa using congrArg e hzero
  · intro hQ x hx
    have he0 : Q' (e x) = 0 := by rw [e.map_app, hx]
    have hex : e x = 0 := hQ _ he0
    exact e.injective (by simpa using hex)

end IsometryEquiv

namespace IsRound

variable {F : Type u} [Field F]
variable {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module F V]

/-- In a round form, the ratio of two nonzero represented values is a
similarity factor. -/
theorem ratio_equivalent (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (hQ : Q.IsRound)
    {x y : V} (hx : Q x ≠ 0) (hy : Q y ≠ 0) :
    ((Q x / Q y) • Q).Equivalent Q := by
  obtain ⟨ex⟩ := (hQ (Q x) hx).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨ey⟩ := (hQ (Q y) hy).mp ⟨y, rfl⟩
  let e₀ := ey.symm.smul (Q x / Q y)
  have hforms :
      (Q x / Q y) • (Q y • Q) = Q x • Q := by
    ext z
    simp only [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
    field_simp
  exact ⟨(e₀.trans (IsometryEquiv.ofEq hforms)).trans ex⟩

end IsRound

end QuadraticMap

namespace QuadraticForm

open _root_.QuadraticMap

universe u₁ v₁

variable {F : Type u₁} [Field F]
variable {V : Type v₁} [AddCommGroup V] [Module F V]

/-- A finite-dimensional quadratic form has a half-dimensional totally isotropic subspace.
This includes no nondegeneracy or perpendicular-equality claim. -/
def HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) : Prop :=
  Module.Finite F V ∧ ∃ H : Submodule F V,
    Q.IsTotallyIsotropic H ∧
      2 * Module.finrank F H = Module.finrank F V

private theorem finrank_prodSubmodule
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    [FiniteDimensional F V] [FiniteDimensional F W]
    (H : Submodule F V) (K : Submodule F W) :
    Module.finrank F (H.prod K) =
      Module.finrank F H + Module.finrank F K := by
  rw [(Submodule.prodEquiv H K).finrank_eq, Module.finrank_prod]

private def similarityGraphLinearMap (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (e : (c • Q).IsometryEquiv Q) : V →ₗ[F] V × V :=
  e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap.prod LinearMap.id

private theorem similarityGraphLinearMap_injective
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (e : (c • Q).IsometryEquiv Q) :
    Function.Injective (similarityGraphLinearMap Q c e) := by
  intro x y hxy
  exact congrArg Prod.snd hxy

private def similarityGraph (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (e : (c • Q).IsometryEquiv Q) : Submodule F (V × V) :=
  LinearMap.range (similarityGraphLinearMap Q c e)

private theorem finrank_similarityGraph
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (e : (c • Q).IsometryEquiv Q) :
    Module.finrank F (similarityGraph Q c e) = Module.finrank F V := by
  exact LinearMap.finrank_range_of_inj
    (similarityGraphLinearMap_injective Q c e)

private theorem similarityGraph_isTotallyIsotropic
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (e : (c • Q).IsometryEquiv Q) :
    (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)).IsTotallyIsotropic (similarityGraph Q c e) := by
  rintro y ⟨x, rfl⟩
  rw [QuadraticMap.prod_apply]
  change Q (e x) + (-c • Q) x = 0
  rw [e.map_app]
  change c * Q x + -c * Q x = 0
  simp

namespace HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace

/-- The half-dimensional totally isotropic-subspace property is preserved by
isometry equivalence. -/
theorem map_isometryEquiv
    {W : Type*} [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    [FiniteDimensional F W]
    {Q : QuadraticForm F V} {Q' : QuadraticForm F W}
    (hQ : Q.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace)
    (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :
    Q'.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace := by
  obtain ⟨hfinite, H, hHiso, hHdim⟩ := hQ
  let : Module.Finite F V := hfinite
  refine ⟨inferInstance, H.map e.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap,
    hHiso.map_isometryEquiv e, ?_⟩
  rw [e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_map_eq, hHdim,
    e.toLinearEquiv.finrank_eq]

/-- A product with a scalar multiple inherits a half-dimensional totally
isotropic subspace from the left form. -/
theorem prod_neg_smul_of_left
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (hQ : Q.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace) :
    HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) := by
  obtain ⟨hfinite, H, hHiso, hHdim⟩ := hQ
  let : Module.Finite F V := hfinite
  refine ⟨inferInstance, H.prod H, hHiso.prod (hHiso.smul (-c)), ?_⟩
  rw [finrank_prodSubmodule, Module.finrank_prod]
  omega

/-- A similarity equivalence supplies a half-dimensional totally isotropic
graph in `Q.prod ((-c) • Q)`. -/
theorem prod_neg_smul_of_equivalent [FiniteDimensional F V]
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F) (h : (c • Q).Equivalent Q) :
    HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) := by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  refine ⟨inferInstance, similarityGraph Q c e,
    similarityGraph_isTotallyIsotropic Q c e, ?_⟩
  rw [finrank_similarityGraph, Module.finrank_prod]
  omega

end HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace

private theorem hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_prod_neg_smul_of_left_or_equivalent
    [FiniteDimensional F V] (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F)
    (h : Q.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace ∨
      (c • Q).Equivalent Q) :
    HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) := by
  rcases h with hQ | he
  · exact hQ.prod_neg_smul_of_left Q c
  · exact HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace.prod_neg_smul_of_equivalent
      Q c he

/-- Recursive induction step once lower-rank roundness and the
lower-isotropic induction hypothesis are available. -/
theorem hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_prod_neg_smul_of_not_anisotropic
    [FiniteDimensional F V] (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c : F) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hround : Q.IsRound)
    (hind : ¬ Q.Anisotropic →
      Q.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace)
    (hprod : ¬ (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)).Anisotropic) :
    HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) := by
  by_cases hQ : Q.Anisotropic
  · obtain ⟨⟨x, y⟩, hxy0, hiso⟩ :=
      (QuadraticMap.not_anisotropic_iff_exists _).1 hprod
    change Q x + -c * Q y = 0 at hiso
    have hrel : Q x = c * Q y := by
      calc
        Q x = (Q x + -c * Q y) + c * Q y := by ring
        _ = c * Q y := by rw [hiso, zero_add]
    have hy : Q y ≠ 0 := by
      intro hy0
      have hyv : y = 0 := hQ y hy0
      have hxq : Q x = 0 := by rw [hrel, hy0, mul_zero]
      have hxv : x = 0 := hQ x hxq
      exact hxy0 (Prod.ext hxv hyv)
    have hx : Q x ≠ 0 := hrel.symm ▸ mul_ne_zero hc hy
    have he := hround.ratio_equivalent Q hx hy
    have hratio : Q x / Q y = c := by
      rw [hrel]
      exact mul_div_cancel_right₀ c hy
    rw [hratio] at he
    exact HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace.prod_neg_smul_of_equivalent
      Q c he
  · exact (hind hQ).prod_neg_smul_of_left Q c

/-- Every non-anisotropic rank-two form has an isotropic line, hence the
half-dimensional totally isotropic-subspace property. -/
theorem hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_of_not_anisotropic_finrank_two
    [FiniteDimensional F V] (Q : QuadraticForm F V)
    (hdim : Module.finrank F V = 2) (hQ : ¬ Q.Anisotropic) :
    Q.HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx0, hxQ⟩ :=
    (QuadraticMap.not_anisotropic_iff_exists Q).1 hQ
  refine ⟨inferInstance, Submodule.span F {x}, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro y hy
    rw [Submodule.mem_span_singleton] at hy
    obtain ⟨d, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [Q.map_smul, hxQ, smul_zero]
  · rw [finrank_span_singleton hx0, hdim]

end QuadraticForm

end

module

public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Radical
public import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Powerset

/-!
# Pfister forms

For units `a : Fin n → Fˣ`, this file defines the diagonal expansion of the
`n`-fold quadratic Pfister form

`\[ \langle\!\langle a_0,\ldots,a_{n-1}\rangle\!\rangle
     = \bigotimes_i \langle 1,-a_i\rangle. \]`

Its coordinates are indexed by subsets `s : Finset (Fin n)`.  The coefficient
at `s` is `∏ i ∈ s, -a i`, so the carrier has dimension `2 ^ n`.  The
diagonal expression makes sense over every field.  Under `NeZero (2 : F)`,
all its coefficients are nonzero and Mathlib's radical calculation shows
that the form is nondegenerate.

This is only the quadratic-form foundation.  It defines no
Grothendieck--Witt or Witt ring, hyperbolic quotient, fundamental ideal,
associated graded object, Milnor comparison, or form of the Milnor
conjecture.

## Main definitions

* `QuadraticForm.pfisterWeight`
* `QuadraticForm.pfister`

## Main results

* `QuadraticForm.pfister_apply`
* `QuadraticForm.pfisterWeight_ne_zero`
* `QuadraticForm.pfister_radical`
* `QuadraticForm.pfister_nondegenerate`
* `QuadraticForm.finrank_pfister_carrier`

## References

* T. Y. Lam, *Introduction to Quadratic Forms over Fields*, Chapter X.
* R. Elman, N. Karpenko, A. Merkurjev,
  *The Algebraic and Geometric Theory of Quadratic Forms*.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

open scoped BigOperators

universe u

namespace QuadraticForm

variable (F : Type u) [Field F]

/-- Diagonal coefficient indexed by a subset in the standard expansion of
the `n`-fold Pfister form `⟨⟨a₀,…,aₙ₋₁⟩⟩`. -/
def pfisterWeight {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) : F :=
  ∏ i ∈ s, -(a i : F)

/-- The coefficient of the empty subset in a Pfister form is one. -/
@[simp]
theorem pfisterWeight_empty {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    pfisterWeight F a ∅ = 1 := by
  simp [pfisterWeight]

/-- Adding a fresh index multiplies the Pfister coefficient by the
corresponding negative unit. -/
@[simp]
theorem pfisterWeight_insert {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) (i : Fin n) (hi : i ∉ s) :
    pfisterWeight F a (insert i s) = -(a i : F) * pfisterWeight F a s := by
  simp [pfisterWeight, hi]

/-- Every diagonal coefficient of a Pfister form is nonzero. -/
theorem pfisterWeight_ne_zero {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterWeight F a s ≠ 0 := by
  rw [pfisterWeight, Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff]
  intro i hi
  exact neg_ne_zero.mpr (Units.ne_zero (a i))

/-- The diagonal `n`-fold Pfister form, with one coordinate for each subset
of `Fin n` and coefficient `∏ i ∈ s, -a i` at the coordinate `s`. -/
def pfister {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    QuadraticForm F (Finset (Fin n) → F) :=
  QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares F (pfisterWeight F a)

/-- Evaluation formula for the diagonal Pfister form. -/
@[simp]
theorem pfister_apply {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ)
    (x : Finset (Fin n) → F) :
    pfister F a x =
      ∑ s : Finset (Fin n), pfisterWeight F a s * (x s * x s) := by
  simp [pfister, QuadraticMap.weightedSumSquares_apply]

/-- Over a field of characteristic different from two, an `n`-fold Pfister
form has trivial radical. -/
theorem pfister_radical [NeZero (2 : F)] {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    (pfister F a).radical = ⊥ := by
  rw [pfister, radical_weightedSumSquares]
  ext x
  simp [pfisterWeight_ne_zero, Pi.mem_spanSubset_iff, funext_iff]

/-- Over a field of characteristic different from two, every Pfister form is
nondegenerate. -/
theorem pfister_nondegenerate [NeZero (2 : F)] {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    (pfister F a).Nondegenerate := by
  let _ : Invertible (2 : F) := invertibleOfNonzero (NeZero.ne _)
  rw [QuadraticMap.nondegenerate_iff_radical_eq_bot]
  exact pfister_radical F a

/-- The carrier of an `n`-fold Pfister form has dimension `2 ^ n`. -/
theorem finrank_pfister_carrier (n : ℕ) :
    Module.finrank F (Finset (Fin n) → F) = 2 ^ n := by
  rw [Module.finrank_pi, Fintype.card_finset, Fintype.card_fin]

end QuadraticForm

end

-- Author: @toskua, Avocado
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.PfisterRoundness

/-!
# Half-dimensional isotropic subspaces of Pfister forms

Every non-anisotropic explicit subset-indexed Pfister form has a
half-dimensional totally isotropic subspace.  We also expose the concrete
submodule form needed by the norm-neighbor intersection argument, with rank
exactly half the Pfister carrier dimension.

The proof is characteristic-free and valid for every tuple length at least
one.  This file defines no norm-quadric point, symbol splitting, motive,
VM2, or norm-residue theorem.

## Main declarations

* `QuadraticForm.pfister_hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace`
* `QuadraticForm.pfister_exists_halfDimensionalTotallyIsotropic`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace QuadraticForm

/-- A non-anisotropic explicit Pfister form has a half-dimensional totally
isotropic subspace. -/
theorem pfister_hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
    (F : Type u) [Field F]
    {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ)
    (h : ¬ (pfister F a).Anisotropic) :
    (pfister F a).HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact
        hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_of_not_anisotropic_finrank_two
          (pfister F a) (finrank_pfister_carrier F 1) h
  | succ n ih =>
      let lower : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ := fun i => a i.castSucc
      let c : F := a (Fin.last (n + 1))
      let Q := pfister F lower
      let e := pfisterSuccEquiv F a
      have hc : c ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero (a (Fin.last (n + 1)))
      have hround : Q.IsRound := pfister_isRound F lower
      have hprod : ¬ (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)).Anisotropic := by
        intro hp
        apply h
        exact e.anisotropic_iff.mpr hp
      have hP : HasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace
          (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) :=
        hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace_prod_neg_smul_of_not_anisotropic
          Q c hc hround (fun hlow => ih lower hlow) hprod
      exact hP.map_isometryEquiv e.symm

/-- A non-anisotropic explicit Pfister form has a concrete totally isotropic
submodule of rank exactly half the ambient Pfister dimension. -/
theorem pfister_exists_halfDimensionalTotallyIsotropic
    (F : Type u) [Field F]
    {n : ℕ} (a : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ)
    (h : ¬ (pfister F a).Anisotropic) :
    ∃ H : Submodule F (Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → F),
      Module.finrank F H = 2 ^ n ∧
        ∀ x ∈ H, pfister F a x = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨_, H, hHiso, hHdim⟩ :=
    pfister_hasHalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropicSubspace F a h
  refine ⟨H, ?_, hHiso⟩
  rw [finrank_pfister_carrier, pow_succ] at hHdim
  omega

end QuadraticForm

end

-- Author: @toskua, Avocado
module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Round
public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.PfisterSuccessor

/-!
# Roundness of explicit Pfister forms

Every subset-indexed quadratic Pfister form is round.  The zero-fold form is
the one-coordinate square form.  The successor step uses the canonical
successor-product isometry and preservation of roundness under adjoining a
nonzero binary Pfister factor.

The proof is characteristic-free and assumes no finite dimension,
nondegeneracy, anisotropy, hyperbolicity, or half-dimensional isotropic
subspace.  It proves no norm-quadric point, splitting, VM2, or norm-residue
statement.

## Main declaration

* `QuadraticForm.pfister_isRound`

## Reference

* R. Elman, N. Karpenko, A. Merkurjev,
  *The Algebraic and Geometric Theory of Quadratic Forms*, Corollary 9.9.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u

namespace QuadraticForm

variable (F : Type u) [Field F]

private def pfisterOneVector (n : ℕ) : Finset (Fin n) → F :=
  fun s => if s = ∅ then 1 else 0

private theorem pfister_oneVector
    {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    pfister F a (pfisterOneVector F n) = 1 := by
  classical
  rw [pfister_apply]
  simp [pfisterOneVector]

private noncomputable def scalarLinearEquiv (r : F) (hr : r ≠ 0) :
    F ≃ₗ[F] F := by
  refine LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap (LinearMap.lsmul F F r)
    (LinearMap.lsmul F F r⁻¹) ?_ ?_
  · ext
    simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hr]
  · ext
    simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hr]

@[simp]
private theorem scalarLinearEquiv_apply
    (r : F) (hr : r ≠ 0) (x : F) :
    scalarLinearEquiv F r hr x = r * x :=
  rfl

private theorem pfisterZero_isRound (a : Fin 0 → Fˣ) :
    (pfister F a).IsRound := by
  intro d hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    let r : F := x ∅
    have hQr : pfister F a x = r * r := by
      rw [pfister_apply, Fintype.sum_unique]
      have hdefault : (default : Finset (Fin 0)) = ∅ :=
        Subsingleton.elim _ _
      rw [hdefault, pfisterWeight_empty]
      simp [r]
    have hr : r ≠ 0 := by
      intro hr
      apply hd
      rw [← hx, hQr, hr, zero_mul]
    have hrd : r * r = d := by
      rw [← hx, hQr]
    let eLin : (Finset (Fin 0) → F) ≃ₗ[F] (Finset (Fin 0) → F) :=
      LinearEquiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => scalarLinearEquiv F r hr)
    refine ⟨{ toLinearEquiv := eLin, map_app' := ?_ }⟩
    intro z
    change pfister F a (eLin z) = d * pfister F a z
    rw [pfister_apply, pfister_apply,
      Fintype.sum_unique, Fintype.sum_unique]
    have hdefault : (default : Finset (Fin 0)) = ∅ :=
      Subsingleton.elim _ _
    rw [hdefault, pfisterWeight_empty]
    simp only [one_mul]
    have heval : eLin z ∅ = scalarLinearEquiv F r hr (z ∅) := rfl
    rw [heval, scalarLinearEquiv_apply, ← hrd]
    ring
  · rintro ⟨e⟩
    refine ⟨e (pfisterOneVector F 0), ?_⟩
    rw [e.map_app]
    change d * pfister F a (pfisterOneVector F 0) = d
    rw [pfister_oneVector]
    ring

/-- Every explicit subset-indexed Pfister form is round. -/
theorem pfister_isRound {n : ℕ} (a : Fin n → Fˣ) :
    (pfister F a).IsRound := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      exact pfisterZero_isRound F a
  | succ n ih =>
      let lower : Fin n → Fˣ := fun i => a i.castSucc
      let c : F := a (Fin.last n)
      have hlower : (pfister F lower).IsRound := ih lower
      have hc : c ≠ 0 := Units.ne_zero (a (Fin.last n))
      have hprod :
          ((pfister F lower).prod ((-c) • pfister F lower)).IsRound :=
        hlower.prod_neg_smul c hc
      exact hprod.map_isometryEquiv (pfisterSuccEquiv F a).symm

end QuadraticForm

end

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Pfister
public import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Preimage
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Pi
public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.Prod

/-!
# Successor decomposition of Pfister forms

The subset coordinates of a successor Pfister form split canonically into
two blocks: subsets avoiding the final index, and subsets containing it.
This file packages that partition as a linear equivalence and identifies the
successor Pfister form with the product of the lower Pfister form and its
scalar multiple by the negative final coefficient.

The construction is characteristic-free.  It does not assert roundness,
hyperbolicity, existence of a half-dimensional isotropic subspace, or any
norm-residue consequence.

## Main declarations

* `QuadraticForm.pfisterLowerIndex`
* `QuadraticForm.pfisterUpperIndex`
* `QuadraticForm.pfisterSuccLinearEquiv`
* `QuadraticForm.pfisterSuccEquiv`
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open scoped BigOperators

universe u v

namespace QuadraticForm

/-- Embed a lower-rank Pfister coordinate as a subset avoiding the final
index. -/
def pfisterLowerIndex (n : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin n) ↪ Finset (Fin (n + 1)) where
  toFun s := s.map Fin.castSuccEmb
  inj' := Finset.map_injective Fin.castSuccEmb

/-- Embed a lower-rank Pfister coordinate in the upper block by inserting
the final index. -/
def pfisterUpperIndex (n : ℕ) :
    Finset (Fin n) ↪ Finset (Fin (n + 1)) where
  toFun s := insert (Fin.last n) (pfisterLowerIndex n s)
  inj' := by
    intro s t hst
    have herase := congrArg
      (fun q : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) => q.erase (Fin.last n)) hst
    change
      (insert (Fin.last n) (s.map Fin.castSuccEmb)).erase (Fin.last n) =
        (insert (Fin.last n) (t.map Fin.castSuccEmb)).erase (Fin.last n) at herase
    have hm : s.map Fin.castSuccEmb = t.map Fin.castSuccEmb := by
      simpa using herase
    exact Finset.map_injective Fin.castSuccEmb hm

@[simp]
private theorem last_notMem_pfisterLowerIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Fin.last n ∉ pfisterLowerIndex n s := by
  simp [pfisterLowerIndex]

@[simp]
private theorem last_mem_pfisterUpperIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    Fin.last n ∈ pfisterUpperIndex n s := by
  change Fin.last n ∈ insert (Fin.last n) (pfisterLowerIndex n s)
  simp

/-- The full Pfister coefficient on a lower-block coordinate is the
lower-rank Pfister coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem pfisterWeight_lowerIndex {F : Type u} [Field F] {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterWeight F a (pfisterLowerIndex n s) =
      pfisterWeight F (fun i => a i.castSucc) s := by
  change
    (∏ i ∈ s.map Fin.castSuccEmb, -(a i : F)) =
      ∏ i ∈ s, -(a i.castSucc : F)
  rw [Finset.prod_map]
  rfl

/-- The full Pfister coefficient on an upper-block coordinate is the lower
coefficient multiplied by the negative final coefficient. -/
@[simp]
theorem pfisterWeight_upperIndex {F : Type u} [Field F] {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterWeight F a (pfisterUpperIndex n s) =
      -(a (Fin.last n) : F) *
        pfisterWeight F (fun i => a i.castSucc) s := by
  change
    pfisterWeight F a
      (insert (Fin.last n) (pfisterLowerIndex n s)) = _
  rw [pfisterWeight_insert]
  · rw [pfisterWeight_lowerIndex]
  · exact last_notMem_pfisterLowerIndex n s

private noncomputable def pfisterLowerPart
    (n : ℕ) (t : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  t.preimage Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc_injective n).injOn

@[simp]
private theorem mem_pfisterLowerPart
    (n : ℕ) (t : Finset (Fin (n + 1))) (i : Fin n) :
    i ∈ pfisterLowerPart n t ↔ i.castSucc ∈ t :=
  Finset.mem_preimage

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterLowerPart_lowerIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterLowerPart n (pfisterLowerIndex n s) = s := by
  ext i
  simp [pfisterLowerPart, pfisterLowerIndex]

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterLowerPart_upperIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterLowerPart n (pfisterUpperIndex n s) = s := by
  ext i
  simp [pfisterLowerPart, pfisterUpperIndex, pfisterLowerIndex]

private theorem pfisterLowerIndex_lowerPart
    (n : ℕ) (t : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (h : Fin.last n ∉ t) :
    pfisterLowerIndex n (pfisterLowerPart n t) = t := by
  ext i
  change i ∈ (pfisterLowerPart n t).map Fin.castSuccEmb ↔ i ∈ t
  by_cases hi : i = Fin.last n
  · subst i
    simp [h]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi
    simp

private theorem pfisterUpperIndex_lowerPart
    (n : ℕ) (t : Finset (Fin (n + 1)))
    (h : Fin.last n ∈ t) :
    pfisterUpperIndex n (pfisterLowerPart n t) = t := by
  ext i
  change i ∈ insert (Fin.last n)
      ((pfisterLowerPart n t).map Fin.castSuccEmb) ↔ i ∈ t
  by_cases hi : i = Fin.last n
  · subst i
    simp [h]
  · obtain ⟨j, rfl⟩ := Fin.exists_castSucc_eq.mpr hi
    simp

private noncomputable def pfisterSuccIndexEquiv (n : ℕ) :
    Sum (Finset (Fin n)) (Finset (Fin n)) ≃
      Finset (Fin (n + 1)) where
  toFun := Sum.elim (pfisterLowerIndex n) (pfisterUpperIndex n)
  invFun t := if h : Fin.last n ∈ t then
      Sum.inr (pfisterLowerPart n t)
    else
      Sum.inl (pfisterLowerPart n t)
  left_inv s := by
    cases s with
    | inl s => simp [last_notMem_pfisterLowerIndex]
    | inr s => simp [last_mem_pfisterUpperIndex]
  right_inv t := by
    by_cases h : Fin.last n ∈ t
    · dsimp only
      simp only [h, dite_true]
      exact pfisterUpperIndex_lowerPart n t h
    · dsimp only
      simp only [h, dite_false]
      exact pfisterLowerIndex_lowerPart n t h

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_inl
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n (Sum.inl s) = pfisterLowerIndex n s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_inr
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n (Sum.inr s) = pfisterUpperIndex n s :=
  rfl

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_symm_lowerIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n).symm (pfisterLowerIndex n s) =
      Sum.inl s := by
  exact (pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n).symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl

@[simp]
private theorem pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_symm_upperIndex
    (n : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n).symm (pfisterUpperIndex n s) =
      Sum.inr s := by
  exact (pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n).symm_apply_eq.mpr rfl

/-- Split functions on successor Pfister coordinates into the block avoiding
the final index and the block containing it. -/
noncomputable def pfisterSuccLinearEquiv
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) :
    (Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → M) ≃ₗ[R]
      (Finset (Fin n) → M) × (Finset (Fin n) → M) := by
  let e : Sum (Finset (Fin n)) (Finset (Fin n)) ≃
      Finset (Fin (n + 1)) := {
    toFun := Sum.elim (pfisterLowerIndex n) (pfisterUpperIndex n)
    invFun t := if Fin.last n ∈ t then
        Sum.inr (t.preimage Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc_injective n).injOn)
      else
        Sum.inl (t.preimage Fin.castSucc (Fin.castSucc_injective n).injOn)
    left_inv s := by
      cases s with
      | inl s =>
          dsimp only
          rw [Sum.elim_inl]
          rw [ite_eq_right (last_notMem_pfisterLowerIndex n s)]
          exact congrArg Sum.inl (by
            simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterLowerPart_lowerIndex n s)
      | inr s =>
          dsimp only
          rw [Sum.elim_inr]
          rw [ite_eq_left (last_mem_pfisterUpperIndex n s)]
          exact congrArg Sum.inr (by
            simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterLowerPart_upperIndex n s)
    right_inv t := by
      by_cases h : Fin.last n ∈ t
      · dsimp only
        rw [ite_eq_left h]
        simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterUpperIndex_lowerPart n t h
      · dsimp only
        rw [ite_eq_right h]
        simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterLowerIndex_lowerPart n t h }
  exact
    (LinearEquiv.piCongrLeft' R
        (fun _ : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) => M) e.symm).trans
      (LinearEquiv.sumArrowLequivProdArrow
        (Finset (Fin n)) (Finset (Fin n)) R M)

@[simp]
theorem pfisterSuccLinearEquiv_apply_fst
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) (x : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → M)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccLinearEquiv R n x).1 s =
      x (pfisterLowerIndex n s) := by
  simp [pfisterSuccLinearEquiv]

@[simp]
theorem pfisterSuccLinearEquiv_apply_snd
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) (x : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) → M)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccLinearEquiv R n x).2 s =
      x (pfisterUpperIndex n s) := by
  simp [pfisterSuccLinearEquiv]

@[simp]
theorem pfisterSuccLinearEquiv_symm_apply_lowerIndex
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) (x y : Finset (Fin n) → M)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccLinearEquiv R n).symm (x, y)
        (pfisterLowerIndex n s) = x s := by
  simp [pfisterSuccLinearEquiv]
  congr 1
  simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterLowerPart_lowerIndex n s

@[simp]
theorem pfisterSuccLinearEquiv_symm_apply_upperIndex
    (R : Type u) [Semiring R]
    {M : Type v} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
    (n : ℕ) (x y : Finset (Fin n) → M)
    (s : Finset (Fin n)) :
    (pfisterSuccLinearEquiv R n).symm (x, y)
        (pfisterUpperIndex n s) = y s := by
  simp [pfisterSuccLinearEquiv]
  congr 1
  simpa [pfisterLowerPart] using pfisterLowerPart_upperIndex n s

/-- A successor Pfister form is isometric to the product of the lower form
and its scalar multiple by the negative final coefficient. -/
noncomputable def pfisterSuccEquiv
    (F : Type u) [Field F] {n : ℕ}
    (a : Fin (n + 1) → Fˣ) :
    (pfister F a).IsometryEquiv
      ((pfister F (fun i => a i.castSucc)).prod
        ((-(a (Fin.last n) : F)) •
          pfister F (fun i => a i.castSucc))) where
  toLinearEquiv := pfisterSuccLinearEquiv F n
  map_app' x := by
    rw [QuadraticMap.prod_apply, smul_apply,
      pfister_apply, pfister_apply, pfister_apply]
    change
      (∑ s : Finset (Fin n),
          pfisterWeight F (fun i => a i.castSucc) s *
            (x (pfisterLowerIndex n s) *
              x (pfisterLowerIndex n s))) +
        -(a (Fin.last n) : F) *
          (∑ s : Finset (Fin n),
            pfisterWeight F (fun i => a i.castSucc) s *
              (x (pfisterUpperIndex n s) *
                x (pfisterUpperIndex n s))) =
      ∑ t : Finset (Fin (n + 1)),
        pfisterWeight F a t * (x t * x t)
    rw [← Equiv.sum_comp (pfisterSuccIndexEquiv n)
      (fun t : Finset (Fin (n + 1)) =>
        pfisterWeight F a t * (x t * x t))]
    rw [Fintype.sum_sum_type]
    simp only [pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_inl,
      pfisterSuccIndexEquiv_inr, pfisterWeight_lowerIndex,
      pfisterWeight_upperIndex]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro s hs
    ring

end QuadraticForm

end

module

public import MathlibExt.LinearAlgebra.QuadraticForm.HalfDimensionalTotallyIsotropic

/-!
# Round quadratic forms and binary Pfister products

This file proves that roundness is preserved by isometry equivalence and by
adjoining a nonzero binary Pfister factor.  The product theorem uses an
explicit strong-multiplicativity matrix on
`Q.prod ((-c) • Q)` and follows EKM Proposition 9.8(1).

The proof is characteristic-free.  It assumes no finite dimension,
nondegeneracy, anisotropy, hyperbolicity, or half-dimensional isotropic
subspace, and introduces no second similarity-factor predicate.

## Main declarations

* `QuadraticMap.IsRound.map_isometryEquiv`
* `QuadraticMap.IsRound.prod_neg_smul`

## Reference

* R. Elman, N. Karpenko, A. Merkurjev,
  *The Algebraic and Geometric Theory of Quadratic Forms*, Proposition 9.8.
-/

@[expose] public section

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

universe u v w

namespace QuadraticMap.IsRound

variable {F : Type u} [Field F]
variable {V : Type v} [AddCommGroup V] [Module F V]

private def binaryMulLinearMap (c p q : F) :
    (V × V) →ₗ[F] (V × V) :=
  (((p • LinearMap.fst F V V) +
      ((c * q) • LinearMap.snd F V V)).prod
    ((q • LinearMap.fst F V V) +
      (p • LinearMap.snd F V V)))

@[simp]
private theorem binaryMulLinearMap_apply (c p q : F) (x y : V) :
    binaryMulLinearMap (V := V) c p q (x, y) =
      (p • x + (c * q) • y, q • x + p • y) :=
  rfl

private def binaryMulInverseLinearMap (c p q d : F) :
    (V × V) →ₗ[F] (V × V) :=
  ((((d⁻¹ * p) • LinearMap.fst F V V) +
      ((-(d⁻¹ * c * q)) • LinearMap.snd F V V)).prod
    (((-(d⁻¹ * q)) • LinearMap.fst F V V) +
      ((d⁻¹ * p) • LinearMap.snd F V V)))

@[simp]
private theorem binaryMulInverseLinearMap_apply
    (c p q d : F) (x y : V) :
    binaryMulInverseLinearMap (V := V) c p q d (x, y) =
      ((d⁻¹ * p) • x + (-(d⁻¹ * c * q)) • y,
        (-(d⁻¹ * q)) • x + (d⁻¹ * p) • y) :=
  rfl

private noncomputable def binaryMulLinearEquiv
    (c p q : F) (hd : p * p - c * (q * q) ≠ 0) :
    (V × V) ≃ₗ[F] (V × V) := by
  let d := p * p - c * (q * q)
  let f := binaryMulLinearMap (V := V) c p q
  let g := binaryMulInverseLinearMap (V := V) c p q d
  have hd₂ : p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by
    simpa [pow_two] using hd
  refine LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap f g ?_ ?_
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    ext <;> simp only [f, g, d, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      binaryMulLinearMap_apply, binaryMulInverseLinearMap_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply]
    all_goals module_nf
    · conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul F x]
      congr 1
      calc
        _ = (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2) * (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hd₂
    · conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul F y]
      congr 1
      calc
        _ = (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2) * (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hd₂
  · apply LinearMap.ext
    rintro ⟨x, y⟩
    ext <;> simp only [f, g, d, LinearMap.comp_apply,
      binaryMulLinearMap_apply, binaryMulInverseLinearMap_apply,
      LinearMap.id_apply]
    all_goals module_nf
    · conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul F x]
      congr 1
      calc
        _ = (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2) * (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hd₂
    · conv_rhs => rw [← one_smul F y]
      congr 1
      calc
        _ = (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2) * (p ^ 2 - c * q ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        _ = 1 := mul_inv_cancel₀ hd₂

@[simp]
private theorem binaryMulLinearEquiv_apply
    (c p q : F) (hd : p * p - c * (q * q) ≠ 0) (x y : V) :
    binaryMulLinearEquiv (V := V) c p q hd (x, y) =
      (p • x + (c * q) • y, q • x + p • y) :=
  rfl

private noncomputable def binaryMulIsometryEquiv
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c p q : F)
    (hd : p * p - c * (q * q) ≠ 0) :
    ((p * p - c * (q * q)) • (Q.prod ((-c) • Q))).IsometryEquiv
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) where
  toLinearEquiv := binaryMulLinearEquiv (V := V) c p q hd
  map_app' z := by
    rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
    change Q (p • x + (c * q) • y) +
        (-c • Q) (q • x + p • y) =
      ((p * p - c * (q * q)) • (Q.prod ((-c) • Q))) (x, y)
    simp only [QuadraticMap.prod_apply, smul_apply]
    rw [QuadraticMap.map_add Q (p • x) ((c * q) • y),
      QuadraticMap.map_add Q (q • x) (p • y),
      Q.map_smul, Q.map_smul, Q.map_smul, Q.map_smul,
      Q.polar_smul_left, Q.polar_smul_right,
      Q.polar_smul_left, Q.polar_smul_right]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul]
    ring

private theorem similarity_prod_of_similarity
    (Q : QuadraticForm F V) (c d : F)
    (h : (d • Q).Equivalent Q) :
    (d • (Q.prod ((-c) • Q))).Equivalent
      (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) := by
  obtain ⟨e⟩ := h
  let ep := e.prod (e.smul (-c))
  have hsource :
      d • (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)) =
        (d • Q).prod ((-c) • (d • Q)) := by
    ext z
    rcases z with ⟨x, y⟩
    simp only [QuadraticMap.prod_apply, smul_apply]
    ring
  exact ⟨(IsometryEquiv.ofEq hsource).trans ep⟩

private theorem similarity_mul
    (P : QuadraticForm F V) (c d : F)
    (hc : (c • P).Equivalent P)
    (hd : (d • P).Equivalent P) :
    ((c * d) • P).Equivalent P := by
  obtain ⟨ec⟩ := hc
  obtain ⟨ed⟩ := hd
  have hsource : (c * d) • P = c • (d • P) := by
    ext x
    simp only [smul_apply]
    ring
  exact ⟨(IsometryEquiv.ofEq hsource).trans ((ed.smul c).trans ec)⟩

private theorem similarity_transport
    {W : Type w} [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {P : QuadraticForm F V} {P' : QuadraticForm F W}
    (e : P.IsometryEquiv P')
    (d : F) (h : (d • P).Equivalent P) :
    (d • P').Equivalent P' := by
  obtain ⟨ed⟩ := h
  exact ⟨(e.symm.smul d).trans (ed.trans e)⟩

/-- Roundness is preserved by isometry equivalence. -/
theorem map_isometryEquiv
    {W : Type w} [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W]
    {Q : QuadraticForm F V} {Q' : QuadraticForm F W}
    (hQ : Q.IsRound) (e : Q.IsometryEquiv Q') :
    Q'.IsRound := by
  intro d hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, hx⟩
    have hxQ : Q (e.symm x) = d := by
      rw [← e.map_app]
      simpa using hx
    have hsim : (d • Q).Equivalent Q :=
      (hQ d hd).mp ⟨e.symm x, hxQ⟩
    exact similarity_transport e d hsim
  · intro hsim'
    have hsim : (d • Q).Equivalent Q :=
      similarity_transport e.symm d hsim'
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := (hQ d hd).mpr hsim
    refine ⟨e x, ?_⟩
    rw [e.map_app, hx]

/-- Adjoining a nonzero binary Pfister factor preserves roundness. -/
theorem prod_neg_smul
    {Q : QuadraticForm F V} (hQ : Q.IsRound)
    (c : F) (hc : c ≠ 0) :
    (Q.prod ((-c) • Q)).IsRound := by
  let P := Q.prod ((-c) • Q)
  have hOne : ∃ e : V, Q e = 1 :=
    (hQ 1 one_ne_zero).mpr (by
      simpa only [one_smul] using Equivalent.refl Q)
  intro d hd
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨⟨x, y⟩, hxy⟩
    change Q x + -c * Q y = d at hxy
    by_cases hx : Q x = 0
    · have hy : Q y ≠ 0 := by
        intro hy
        apply hd
        rw [← hxy, hx, hy]
        ring
      have hyQ : ((Q y) • Q).Equivalent Q :=
        (hQ (Q y) hy).mp ⟨y, rfl⟩
      have hyP : ((Q y) • P).Equivalent P :=
        similarity_prod_of_similarity Q c (Q y) hyQ
      have hnegc : ((-c) • P).Equivalent P := by
        have hdet : 0 * 0 - c * (1 * 1) ≠ 0 := by
          simpa using neg_ne_zero.mpr hc
        refine ⟨?_⟩
        simpa only [P, zero_mul, one_mul, mul_one, zero_sub] using
          binaryMulIsometryEquiv Q c 0 1 hdet
      have hprod := similarity_mul P (-c) (Q y) hnegc hyP
      have hdc : d = (-c) * Q y := by
        rw [← hxy, hx]
        ring
      simpa [hdc] using hprod
    · by_cases hy : Q y = 0
      · have hxQ : ((Q x) • Q).Equivalent Q :=
          (hQ (Q x) hx).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩
        have hxP : ((Q x) • P).Equivalent P :=
          similarity_prod_of_similarity Q c (Q x) hxQ
        have hdx : d = Q x := by
          rw [← hxy, hy]
          ring
        simpa [hdx] using hxP
      · let t : F := c * (Q y / Q x)
        have hratioQ : ((Q y / Q x) • Q).Equivalent Q :=
          hQ.ratio_equivalent Q hy hx
        obtain ⟨eratio⟩ := hratioQ
        let eSecond : ((-t) • Q).IsometryEquiv ((-c) • Q) := by
          have hsource : (-t) • Q = (-c) • ((Q y / Q x) • Q) := by
            ext z
            simp only [t, smul_apply]
            ring
          exact (IsometryEquiv.ofEq hsource).trans (eratio.smul (-c))
        let eProd : (Q.prod ((-t) • Q)).IsometryEquiv P :=
          (IsometryEquiv.refl Q).prod eSecond
        have hdt : 1 - t ≠ 0 := by
          intro hzero
          have ht : t = 1 := (sub_eq_zero.mp hzero).symm
          dsimp only [t] at ht
          field_simp [hx] at ht
          apply hd
          rw [← hxy, ← ht]
          ring
        have hbin : ((1 - t) • (Q.prod ((-t) • Q))).Equivalent
            (Q.prod ((-t) • Q)) := by
          have hdet : 1 * 1 - t * (1 * 1) ≠ 0 := by
            simpa using hdt
          refine ⟨?_⟩
          simpa only [one_mul, mul_one] using
            binaryMulIsometryEquiv Q t 1 1 hdet
        have hfactor : ((1 - t) • P).Equivalent P :=
          similarity_transport eProd (1 - t) hbin
        have hxQ : ((Q x) • Q).Equivalent Q :=
          (hQ (Q x) hx).mp ⟨x, rfl⟩
        have hxP : ((Q x) • P).Equivalent P :=
          similarity_prod_of_similarity Q c (Q x) hxQ
        have hprod := similarity_mul P (Q x) (1 - t) hxP hfactor
        have hdprod : d = Q x * (1 - t) := by
          rw [← hxy]
          dsimp only [t]
          field_simp [hx]
          ring
        simpa [hdprod] using hprod
  · intro hsim
    obtain ⟨e⟩ := hsim
    obtain ⟨one, hone⟩ := hOne
    refine ⟨e (one, 0), ?_⟩
    rw [e.map_app]
    simp [smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, QuadraticMap.prod_apply, hone]

end QuadraticMap.IsRound
